description: From the garden end of Plaza Vázquez de Molina, Úbeda's Renaissance monuments are lit like beacons against the night — the Sacra Capilla del Salvador with its tall campanile at the center, Spain's largest civil mausoleum, flanked by golden-stone palaces. On a clear 23°C night with the orange-tree gardens quiet and empty, walking this UNESCO-listed plaza under the lights comes as close to the mystical as Úbeda gets.
